questions.question: Which shortcut opens the Command Palette, a search box for every VS Code feature?
questions.explanation: ⌘ + Shift + P opens the Command Palette. ⌘ + P (without Shift) quickly opens files by name.

questions.question: What does F2 do on a variable name?
questions.explanation: F2 is a safe 'rename symbol': it updates every place that name is used, unlike find-and-replace, which can hit unrelated text.

questions.question: Why should you open a whole folder in VS Code instead of a single file?
options: VS Code can then understand the whole project: search, imports, Git and the terminal
questions.explanation: Features like project-wide search, go-to-definition across files and Git integration need to know the project folder.

questions.question: What does a formatter do?
options: Automatically tidies spacing and layout to a consistent style
questions.explanation: Formatters like Ruff or Black apply a style (like PEP 8) automatically, so you never think about spacing.
